verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a built-in Vanta AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues. The pricing page lists agentic search and asking questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents. Additional built-in agents cover TPRM and end-to-end questionnaire workflows. The external MCP server is not counted here, since it serves third-party assistants rather than being a built-in one. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are delegated to the agent and what its limits or approval flow are, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent performs as marketed.
